test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

Riddhi believes in __wearing her heart on her sleeve__. That is why she has so many friends.

options.text: To wear a badge of honour
To openly and freely express one’s emotions

solution: The correct answer is: **'****To openly and freely express one’s emotions**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"wearing her heart on her sleeve"** means to openly and freely express one’s emotions. (अपनी भावनाओं को खुलकर व्यक्त करना) • **Example:** She is known for **wearing her heart on her sleeve**, never hiding her true feelings. • **"To openly and freely express one’s emotions" **means not hiding what you feel and being transparent about your emotions. (अपनी भावनाओं को खुलकर और स्वतंत्र रूप से व्यक्त करना) • **Example:** His habit of **openly and freely expressing his emotions** makes him very approachable. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To criticise everybody **(हर किसी की आलोचना करना): To find fault or express disapproval of everyone. • **Example:** He tends to **criticise everybody**, which makes him unpopular among his peers. • **To wear a badge of honour **(सम्मान का प्रतीक पहनना): To show something proudly as a sign of achievement. • **Example:** He wears his military service as a **badge of honour**. • **To talk aloud **(जोर से बात करना): To speak in a loud voice. • **Example:** She **tends to talk aloud** when she's excited. 210:Tca0, The correct answer is: '**To fight**'.
